method: Re-listed the complete open PR collection and current main through the authenticated palmoni5 GitHub connector. Reused previously verified local objects for 65 unchanged listed head/base pairs. Retrieved only required missing objects for current main and the 12 new/changed pairs; no existing source branch or PR update was requested. Recomputed three-dot changed path sets from each exact listed pair with rename detection disabled so both sides remain visible, then intersected them with the 14 exact production paths of the pinned root candidate. Inspected only the newly relevant PR506 navigation patch; inherited the unchanged PR414 hunk decision. Newly landed main paths were checked against both production and complete continuation path sets. File-path screening is not a general review of unrelated behavior.
